requirement: An EmDash template provision freezes its installed token ruler and late polls cannot replace it

oracle.invariant: Host stores the token snapshot before done; missing or oversized sources and an unreadable root leave the ruler unknown. The rendered root selects dark values and fonts resolve from the installed font definitions. The token parser loads without workspace dependencies. Only the original provision job can fill a null ruler. Repeated polls leave the first ruler unchanged; another job or Build/Apply writer is never overwritten and no absent record is invented.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
